specific_diseases_listed: Cataract, Glaucoma, disorders of lens, disorders of retina
Pancreatitis and stones in biliary and urinary system
Abnormal utero-vaginal bleeding, female genital prolapse, endometriosis/adenomyosis, fibroids, PCOD, hysterectomy
All benign or in situ neoplasms/tumors, cyst, sinus, polyp, nodules, swelling, mass or lump
Hyperplasia of prostate, hydrocele, varicocele, spermatocele
Hemorrhoids, fissure/fistula/abscess of anal/rectal region, pilonidal sinus, rectal prolapse
Osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, gout, intervertebral disc disorders, joint replacement
Middle ear & mastoid disease, tonsils & adenoids, nasal septum, nasal sinuses/polyp
Gastritis, GERD, ulcer, erosion, varices of upper GI tract

inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Includes room rent, ICU/CCU/HDU, OT, doctor fees, medicines, diagnostics, internally implanted prosthetics

day_care_treatments.limit_text: All listed day-care procedures per Acko day care list

domiciliary_treatment.notes: Covered if continues for at least 3 consecutive days; reimbursement only

ayush_coverage.notes: In-patient AYUSH treatment only - Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy

organ_donor_expenses.notes: Donor in-patient harvesting expenses up to insured's SI; excludes pre/post hospitalization, screening, acquisition, transport

ambulance_cover.notes: Reasonable road ambulance / public transport cost up to sum insured

worldwide_emergency_cover.notes: Treatment outside India excluded unless Worldwide In-Patient Hospitalization cover is available per schedule

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: Network-based preventive tests for insureds >18 years; reimbursable up to Rs 900 if network not available
preventive_health_checkup.notes: CBC, ESR, HbA1C, Sr Creatinine, Lipid profile, RUA, SGOT, SGPT, GGT, Uric Acid

modern_treatments.notes: Uterine Artery Embolization, HIFU, Balloon Sinuplasty, Deep Brain Stimulation, Oral chemotherapy, Immunotherapy, Intravitreal injections, Robotic surgeries, Stereotactic radiosurgeries, Bronchial Thermoplasty, IONM, Stem cell therapy (hematopoietic for BMT)

room_rent_capping: No cap (actual room rent and ICU charges covered)
deductible_notes: Individual deductible applies per member on cumulative admissible claims as specified in schedule; does not reduce SI
permanent_exclusions: Treatment outside India (unless Worldwide IP cover available)
OPD (unless OPD add-on opted or part of pre/post hospitalization)
Substance abuse / addictions; tobacco-user oral/oropharynx/respiratory cancer
Hazardous / adventure sports as a professional
Muscle stimulation (except for fractures and dislocations)
Obesity surgery not meeting BMI criteria
Breach of law with criminal intent
Treatments at health hydros, nature cure, spas
notable_exclusions_summary: Treatment outside India unless Worldwide IP cover available; OPD unless OPD add-on; maternity (except ectopic); sleep disorders; sexually transmitted diseases except HIV; professional hazardous sports; experimental treatments.
claim_process_summary: Two modes: Cashless at network hospitals (planned: notify 2 days before; emergency: within 48 hours; pre-auth TAT 1 hour, final bill TAT 3 hours) or Reimbursement (submit within 15 days of discharge via app). Settlement within 15 days; penal interest 2% above RBI bank rate for delay.
